technical_reference.title: Quantum and Dance: It Takes 2 to Entangle

serendipity_bridge.synthesis_notes: A durable, carefully selected project artifact can carry context across time and distance.

core_essence.foundation: An entangled group has a joint quantum state that cannot be described as independent states for each particle, even when separated. Measurement outcomes can be correlated, but they are not controllable signals.
core_essence.philosophical_anchor: Nonclassical correlations are a feature of quantum systems; the project uses this only as a metaphor for coordination.
core_essence.functional_role: A project-design metaphor for keeping related work coordinated across teams; ordinary communication and explicit state updates are still required.

nonlocal_correlation.definition: Measurements on entangled systems can exhibit correlations that cannot be explained by a classical local hidden-variable model; entanglement alone cannot transmit information faster than light.
nonlocal_correlation.project_application: Use as a reminder to make shared state explicit across tools and teams; it does not imply automatic or instantaneous synchronization.

measurement_outcome.definition: A measurement produces an outcome described by quantum theory; the details depend on the system and measurement.
measurement_outcome.project_application: Use project reviews as a metaphor for choosing among options; review does not physically collapse a project state.

cross_reference_links.synergy: A high-density message can support asynchronous coordination, but communication still uses ordinary channels.

adventure_quests.title: The Golden Artifact Protocol
adventure_quests.objective: Distill a multi-week project roadmap into a concise, source-linked review artifact.
adventure_quests.outcome: A portable summary that supports asynchronous alignment without promising instantaneous agreement.
